articles.title: Exclusive: Positron raises $230M Series B to take on Nvidia’s AI chips
articles.summary: The investment comes from backers including the Qatar Investment Authority as demand for chips beyond Nvidia soars and as Qatar aims to build out its AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Intel will start making GPUs, a market dominated by Nvidia
articles.summary: Intel has been bulking up a team to focus on this effort and will develop its GPU strategy around customer needs.

articles.title: Xcode moves into agentic coding with deeper OpenAI and Anthropic integrations
articles.summary: Xcode 26.3 offers agentic coding capabilities with Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex.

articles.title: Lotus Health nabs $35M for AI doctor that sees patients for free
articles.summary: This AI doctor is licensed in all 50 states, the startup says. The deal was led by CRV and Kleiner Perkins.

articles.title: Fitbit founders launch AI platform to help families monitor their health
articles.summary: Luffu uses AI in the background to gather and organize family information, learn day-to-day patterns, and flag notable changes so families can stay aligned and address potential well-being issues.

articles.title: Peak XV says internal disagreement led to partner exits as it doubles down on AI
articles.summary: Peak XV is transitioning board roles and opening a U.S. office while continuing to view India as its largest market.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX officially acquires Elon Musk’s xAI, with plan to build data centers in space
articles.summary: The merger creates the world's most valuable private company and paves the way for Musk to try and prove out the usefulness of space-based data centers.

articles.summary: Snowflake is the latest enterprise to sign multi-year deals with multiple AI companies in what could be a sign to come of a future trend.

articles.title: Firefox will soon let you block all of its generative AI features
articles.summary: Starting with Firefox 148 arriving later this month, users will find a new AI controls section within the desktop browser settings.

articles.title: OpenAI launches new macOS app for agentic coding
articles.summary: OpenAI has released a new macOS app for Codex, integrating many of the agentic coding practices that have become popular since Codex launched last year.

articles.title: Ring brings its ‘Search Party’ feature for finding lost dogs to non-Ring camera owners
articles.summary: Ring's Search Party feature for finding lost dogs is now available across the U.S. — even if you don't own a Ring camera.

articles.title: Carbon Robotics built an AI model that detects and identifies plants
articles.summary: Carbon Robotics' Large Plant Model will allow farmers to kill new types of weeds without having to retrain the machines.

articles.title: Coalition demands federal Grok ban over nonconsensual sexual content
articles.summary: Nonprofits urge the U.S. government to suspend Grok in federal agencies after the xAI chatbot generated thousands of nonconsensual sexual images, raising national security and child safety concerns.

articles.title: Linq raises $20M to enable AI assistants to live within messaging apps
articles.summary: Linq offers an API that lets companies offer their AI assistants via iMessage, RCS, and SMS.

articles.title: These AI notetaking devices can help you record and transcribe your meetings
articles.summary: These physical notetakers transcribe audio and give users summaries and action items of meetings using AI. Some even offer live translation.

articles.title: Why Tether’s CEO is everywhere right now
articles.summary: For years, Tether's CEO avoided the United States, watching from offshore as regulators circled and prosecutors investigated. Those days are over.

articles.title: Indonesia ‘conditionally’ lifts ban on Grok
articles.summary: Indonesia has followed Malaysia and the Philippines in lifting a ban on xAI’s chatbot Grok.

articles.title: India offers zero taxes through 2047 to lure global AI workloads

articles.summary: As American Tower continues to push for payment

articles.summary: Housed at Digital Realty's data center in Woking, Surrey

articles.title: Tesla sets battery storage deployment record in Q4 as EV sales slump
articles.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said “energy will have very high growth for as far into the future as we can imagine.”

articles.title: Tariffs lifted nonresidential construction costs 3.2% in 2025
articles.summary: Trade policy will “continue to put upward pressure on certain materials” in 2026, said the chief economist for Associated Builders and Contractors. In December, copper wire and cable jumped 22% year over year. Iron and steel were up 12%.

articles.title: Quick fixes won’t solve high energy bills
articles.summary: As grid spending increases, policymakers should look beyond residential customers to cover costs, writes Arjun Krishnaswami, a senior fellow at the Federation of American Scientists.

articles.title: Transmission planning, development improved since 2023 in most US regions: report
articles.summary: However, the grade for Texas slipped to a "D-” and the Southeast continues to get failing marks, according to a report released Tuesday by Americans for a Clean Energy Grid.

articles.title: Trump administration is now 0-5 in latest effort to halt offshore wind
articles.summary: Ørsted’s 924-MW Sunrise Wind was the fifth and final affected project to win a preliminary injunction. Like others, it said the government refused to share information about alleged national security risks invoked in the blanket ban.

articles.title: Energy Star gets full 2026 funding from Congress
articles.summary: Despite the Trump administration’s effort to eliminate the program, it received $33 million as part of a fiscal 2026 funding bill signed by the president.

articles.title: Gas, electricity prices spiked year over year in November: EIA
articles.summary: The residential price of electricity rose 5.5% in November compared with November 2024, while the price of gas rose 88.5%, according to the Energy Information Administration.

articles.title: The AI boom needs power. Tariffs can make it fair.
articles.summary: Large load tariffs can be used to deliver community benefits, lock in clean, reliable power and strengthen energy resilience, writes Ava Community Energy’s Olivia Vasquez.

articles.title: Coal plant owners say DOE ‘emergency’ order to run it violates Constitution
articles.summary: By mandating the generator’s availability to operate, the order “constitutes both a physical taking and a regulatory taking” of property by the government without just compensation or due process, they said in a request for rehearing.

articles.title: How to unlock a tidal wave at the grid edge
articles.summary: Solar plus storage can unlock latent distribution grid capacity at scale.

articles.title: KHNP takes stake in TerraPower
articles.summary: South Korea's SK Innovation has transferred part of its stake in US small modular reactor developer TerraPower to Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power.

articles.title: International safety assessments of Finnish, French SMRs
articles.summary: Nuclear safety authorities from the Czech Republic, Finland, Poland, Sweden, and Ukraine are conducting a Joint Early Review to assess the safety of Steady Energy's LDR-50 reactor for district heating. Meanwhile, the third phase of a review of safety options for France's Nuward SMR has been started by eight European nuclear regulators.

articles.title: Tepco halts restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactor
articles.summary: Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company has temporarily shut down unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant after an alarm was triggered in the control rod operation monitoring system. Before Wednesday's restart, the unit had been offline for almost 14 years.

articles.title: First VVER-1200 fuel delivered to China for Tianwan 7
articles.summary: Rosatom has supplied fuel for the initial loading for Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant's unit 7, which is a VVER-1200 reactor.

articles.title: Amentum-led consortium contracted for Dutch new-build programme
articles.summary: The NEXUS-NL consortium - comprising Amentum, Arcadis, Tractebel, and NRG-Pallas - has been awarded a EUR180 million contract by the Dutch government to provide programme management and technical solutions for planning and development of nuclear new-build in the Netherlands.

articles.title: Laramide pulls out of Kazakh project citing law change
articles.summary: Laramide Resources Ltd has terminated an agreement for a greenfield uranium project in Kazakhstan saying recent changes to the country's subsoil use laws have limited the scope for third-party participation in Kazakh projects, but Kazakhstan's national atomic company says that regulatory limitations for subsoil users are not new.

articles.title: EDF seeking maximum use of existing UK reactors
articles.summary: EDF said its UK nuclear fleet performance was "very good" in 2025, meeting 12% of total UK electricity consumption. The company said it plans to operate its last two Advanced Gas-cooled Reactors until at least 2030 and is seeking a 20-year licence extension for the Sizewell B pressurised water reactor.

articles.title: EnergySolutions sets date for Kewaunee licence application
articles.summary: The Utah-based nuclear services company has formally confirmed its plans to submit an application for a major licensing action for new nuclear generation at the Wisconsin site by June 2028.

articles.title: Denmark begins study on potential use of nuclear energy
articles.summary: A framework is now in place for investigating the "potential and risks" of new nuclear technologies - including small modular reactors - and the lifting of a moratorium on nuclear power, Denmark's Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities has announced.

articles.title: Bureau Veritas to aid Dutch deployment of Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Dutch nuclear energy development and consultancy company ULC-Energy BV has signed an agreement with France-based testing, inspection and certification services provider Bureau Veritas to collaborate on the deployment of the Rolls-Royce SMR in the Netherlands on an industrial scale.

articles.title: Reactor internals delivered for Xudabao unit 1
articles.summary: The reactor internals for Xudabao Nuclear Power Plant's Unit 1 have been delivered to the site, the Chinese project company has announced.

articles.title: Civil construction of replacement Trino waste store completed
articles.summary: The demolition and subsequent reconstruction of a temporary storage facility for low-level radioactive waste has been completed at Italy's Trino nuclear power plant, which is undergoing decommissioning.

articles.title: Kairos secures HALEU for Hermes' first fuel load
articles.summary: Kairos Power has finalised a contract with the US Department of Energy to receive the high-assay low-enriched uranium that will be used to make the fuel for the startup and operation of its Hermes low-power demonstration reactor.

articles.title: Drone test flights prove possibilities for use in fusion
articles.summary: A drone mounted with cameras and sensors has been used for the first time to inspect the Joint European Torus former fusion research facility at the UK Atomic Energy Authority's Culham Campus, in Oxfordshire, UK.

articles.title: Plans for two new reactors confirmed by South Korea
articles.summary: South Korea still plans to construct two new large nuclear power reactors by 2038, in line with its 11th Basic Plan for Electricity Supply and Demand, Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment Kim Sung-hwan has said.

articles.title: Argentina planning to reactivate heavy water plant
articles.summary: Argentina's National Atomic Energy Commission says it will carry out maintenance duties at the Neuquén Heavy Water Industrial Plant, and prepare a bidding process for the work necessary to restart production.

articles.title: UK-US partnership for HALEU transport packages
articles.summary: The UK's Nuclear Transport Solutions has signed a strategic agreement with Westinghouse of the USA to work together on the development of Pegasus – NTS's package designed for the safe transport of high-assay low-enriched uranium fuel.

articles.title: Oak Ridge at heart of US enrichment supply chain developments
articles.summary: BWX Technologies and Centrus Energy have marked major milestones as they build up their centrifuge manufacturing capacity in Tennessee, with BWXT opening a new facility and Centrus announcing major expansion plans, while laser enrichment technology LIS Technologies is also investing in Oak Ridge.

articles.title: Stellaria seeks permission to build experimental reactor
articles.summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has announced it is seeking the necessary authorisations to construct an experimental reactor. Its application is now under review.

articles.title: Zhangzhou 3's steam generators lifted into place
articles.summary: The third and final steam generator was moved into position at Zhangzhou nuclear power plant unit 3 on 26 January, the third of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in China's Fujian province.
